6.q: Explain the correct sequence of effects by which Rajput clan rivalry first strengthened and then weakened their kingdoms.
6.a: The paradox unfolds in stages: (1) Clan pride inspires fort architecture (2) Warrior culture and battlefield tales flourish (3) Long-term political alliances fail to form (4) Disunited kingdoms fall to external conquest. A wrong answer that treats the Rajput defeat as simple cowardice shows the student has not grasped the analysis that the very clan pride which produced cultural vitality and strong local defence also prevented the unified front needed against coordinated Turkic invasion.
